test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 4(2)/(5) years at the rate of 7.6% per annum is Rs. 8,778. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 4.8% per annum simple interest in 8(2)/(7) years?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Effective interest rate 1 = 7.6% × 4.4 years = 33.44%

**Principal (P)** = (8778 ÷ 33.44) × 100 = ₹26,250

Effective interest rate 2 = 4.8% × 58/7 years = 278.4/7%

New **Simple Interest** = 26250 × (278.4 ÷ 700) = ₹10,440

**Total Amount** = 26250 + 10440 = ₹36,690

**∴ The correct answer is ₹36,690.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Case 1: **Simple Interest (SI₁)** = ₹8,778, **Time (T₁)** = 4 2/5 years = 4.4 years, **Rate (R₁)** = 7.6%

Case 2: **Rate (R₂)** = 4.8%, **Time (T₂)** = 8 2/7 years = 58/7 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100 | Amount (A) = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17a9cd1cbe4172c26a8513f70b09725c508dca3ea4d2745c002f486aa517e4ff.png] 

Calculating **Principal (P)**:

⇒ 8778 = (P × 7.6 × 4.4) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (8778 × 100) ÷ 33.44

⇒ P = ₹26,250

Calculating **New Simple Interest (SI₂)**:

⇒ SI₂ = (26250 × 4.8 × 58/7) ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = (262.5 × 4.8 × 58) ÷ 7

⇒ SI₂ = 37.5 × 278.4

⇒ SI₂ = ₹10,440

**Amount Payable:**

⇒ Amount = P + SI₂

⇒ Amount = 26250 + 10440 = ₹36,690

**∴ The correct answer is ₹36,690.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

The formula for calculating SI is SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is **Principal**, R is **Rate per annum**, and T is **Time in years**.

Amount Payable

The **Total Amount** (A) at the end of the period is the sum of the **Principal** and the interest earned: A = P + SI.

Effective Interest Rate

Effective rate is the product of the **Annual Rate** and **Time** (R × T), which helps in calculating interest as a percentage of the **Principal** directly.
